# Balanced 3×2 factorial ANOVA power analysis
# Test: main effect of 3-level factor (2 numerator df)
# Effect size: partial eta-squared = 0.06
# Target power: 80%, alpha = 0.05

# Parameters
alpha <- 0.05
target_power <- 0.80
partial_eta_sq <- 0.06
numerator_df <- 2  # 3-level factor has 2 df
factor_levels <- 3
second_factor_levels <- 2
total_cells <- factor_levels * second_factor_levels

# Relationship: partial eta² = λ / (λ + df_error)
# where λ is the noncentrality parameter and df_error = N - p
# N = total sample size, p = number of parameters in full model
# Full model has: 1 intercept + (3-1) + (2-1) + (3-1)(2-1) = 1 + 2 + 1 + 2 = 6 parameters
p <- 1 + (factor_levels - 1) + (second_factor_levels - 1) + (factor_levels - 1) * (second_factor_levels - 1)

cat("Full factorial model parameters:", p, "\n")
cat("Total cells:", total_cells, "\n")
cat("Each cell has n participants\n")
cat("Total N = n *", total_cells, "\n\n")

# Test parameters
critical_f <- qf(1 - alpha, numerator_df, df = Inf)  # approximate upper tail
cat("Critical F-value (df1=2, alpha=0.05, large df):", critical_f, "\n\n")

# Solve for n: minimum participants per cell
# Strategy: search for smallest integer n giving power >= 0.80

power_results <- data.frame(n = integer(), df_error = integer(), lambda = numeric(), power = numeric())

for (n in 1:500) {
  # Total sample size
  N <- n * total_cells
  
  # Error degrees of freedom
  df_error <- N - p
  
  if (df_error <= 0) next
  
  # Convert partial eta² to noncentrality parameter λ
  # partial_eta² = λ / (λ + df_error)
  # λ = partial_eta² * df_error / (1 - partial_eta²)
  lambda <- partial_eta_sq * df_error / (1 - partial_eta_sq)
  
  # Power: P(F > F_crit) where F ~ F(2, df_error, lambda)
  power <- 1 - pf(qf(1 - alpha, numerator_df, df_error), 
                   numerator_df, df_error, ncp = lambda)
  
  power_results <- rbind(power_results, 
                         data.frame(n = n, df_error = df_error, lambda = lambda, power = power))
  
  # Stop once we exceed target power
  if (power >= target_power) break
}

# Display results around the target
target_idx <- which(power_results$power >= target_power)[1]
display_range <- max(1, target_idx - 2):min(nrow(power_results), target_idx + 2)

cat("Power calculation results:\n")
print(power_results[display_range, ], row.names = FALSE)

# Minimum n meeting target power
n_min <- power_results$n[target_idx]
power_achieved <- power_results$power[target_idx]
df_error_achieved <- power_results$df_error[target_idx]
lambda_achieved <- power_results$lambda[target_idx]

cat("\n=== RESULT ===\n")
cat("Minimum participants per cell (n):", n_min, "\n")
cat("Power achieved:", round(power_achieved, 4), "\n")
cat("Total N = n * 6 =", n_min * total_cells, "\n")
cat("Error df =", df_error_achieved, "\n")
cat("Noncentrality parameter λ =", round(lambda_achieved, 4), "\n\n")

# Verify preceding design (n-1)
if (n_min > 1) {
  n_prev <- n_min - 1
  N_prev <- n_prev * total_cells
  df_error_prev <- N_prev - p
  lambda_prev <- partial_eta_sq * df_error_prev / (1 - partial_eta_sq)
  power_prev <- 1 - pf(qf(1 - alpha, numerator_df, df_error_prev), 
                        numerator_df, df_error_prev, ncp = lambda_prev)
  
  cat("Verification - preceding design (n =", n_prev, "):\n")
  cat("  Power:", round(power_prev, 4), "\n")
  cat("  Does not meet 80% target:", power_prev < target_power, "\n\n")
}

# Summary table
cat("=== DESIGN SUMMARY ===\n")
cat("Design: Balanced 3 × 2 factorial ANOVA\n")
cat("Cells: 6 (3 levels × 2 levels)\n")
cat("Test: Main effect of 3-level factor\n")
cat("Numerator df:", numerator_df, "\n")
cat("Effect size (partial η²):", partial_eta_sq, "\n")
cat("Significance level (α):", alpha, "\n")
cat("Target power:", target_power, "\n\n")
cat("MINIMUM SAMPLE SIZE: n =", n_min, "participants per cell\n")
cat("Total N =", n_min * total_cells, "participants\n")
cat("Achieved power:", round(power_achieved, 4), "\n")

# Output for POWER_AGENT_RESULT
result_json <- list(
  results = list(
    list(metric = "sample_size", value = n_min, unit = "participants_per_cell"),
    list(metric = "achieved_power", value = round(power_achieved, 4), unit = "proportion"),
    list(metric = "total_N", value = n_min * total_cells, unit = "participants")
  ),
  verification = list(
    preceding_design_n = if (n_min > 1) n_min - 1 else NA,
    preceding_design_power = if (n_min > 1) round(power_prev, 4) else NA
  )
)

cat("\nPOWER_AGENT_RESULT=")
cat(jsonlite::toJSON(result_json, auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 15))

cat("   - Model: Y ~ A + B + A:B\n")
cat("   - Total parameters p = 1 + 2 + 1 + 2 = 6\n\n")

cat("   - H0: μ_1 = μ_2 = μ_3 (main effect of 3-level factor)\n")
cat("   - H1: at least one level mean differs\n")
cat("   - Numerator df = 3 - 1 = 2\n")
cat("   - Sidedness: two-sided (α split into upper tail of F-distribution)\n")
cat("   - Significance level α = 0.05\n\n")

cat("   - Given: partial η² = 0.06\n")
cat("   - Formula: partial η² = λ / (λ + df_error)\n")
cat("   - Rearranging: λ = (partial η²) × df_error / (1 - partial η²)\n")
cat("   - Example (n=27): df_error = 162 - 6 = 156\n")

df_error_ex <- 162 - 6
lambda_ex <- 0.06 * df_error_ex / (1 - 0.06)
cat("   - λ =", 0.06, "×", df_error_ex, "/", 1 - 0.06, "=", round(lambda_ex, 4), "\n\n")

# 4. Power calculation
cat("4. POWER CALCULATION\n")
cat("   - Test statistic: F(df1=2, df2=156) under H0\n")
cat("   - Critical value: F_0.05(2,156) =", round(qf(0.95, 2, 156), 6), "\n")

cat("   - Power =", round(power_ex, 4), "\n\n")

num_factor_df <- 3 - 1

cat("Model parameters check:\n")
cat("  Intercept: 1\n")
cat("  Main effect A (3 levels): ", num_factor_df, "\n")
cat("  Main effect B (2 levels): ", denom_factor_df, "\n")
cat("  Interaction A:B: ", interaction_df, "\n")
cat("  Total p = ", p_total, "\n\n")

# Check n=27
n_test <- 27
N_total <- n_test * 6
df_error_test <- N_total - p_total

cat("At n =", n_test, "per cell:\n")
cat("  Total N = ", N_total, "\n")
cat("  df_error = ", N_total, "-", p_total, "=", df_error_test, "\n\n")

# Verify effect size conversion formula
# The relationship between partial eta-squared and noncentrality is:
# partial_eta² = λ / (λ + df_error)
# Solving for λ: λ(1 - partial_eta²) = partial_eta² × df_error
#                λ = (partial_eta² × df_error) / (1 - partial_eta²)

lambda_formula <- (partial_eta_sq * df_error_test) / (1 - partial_eta_sq)
cat("Noncentrality parameter λ calculation:\n")
cat("  Formula: λ = η² × df_error / (1 - η²)\n")
cat("  λ =", partial_eta_sq, "×", df_error_test, "/", (1 - partial_eta_sq), "\n")
cat("  λ =", lambda_formula, "\n\n")

cat("Critical F-value:\n")
cat("  F_{α}(", num_df, ",", df_error_test, ") = F_{0.05}(2,", df_error_test, ") =", F_critical, "\n\n")

cat("Power at n = 27:\n")
cat("  Power = P(F > F_crit | ncp = λ)\n")
cat("  Power = 1 - P(F ≤", round(F_critical, 6), "| df1=2, df2=", df_error_test, ", ncp=",

cat("2. EFFECT SIZE → NONCENTRALITY CONVERSION\n")
cat("   In a fixed-effects ANOVA F-test, the noncentrality parameter is:\n")
cat("   λ = (N × partial η²) / (1 - partial η²) × (df_error / total_df)\n")
cat("   \n")
cat("   Equivalently, from the definitional relationship:\n")
cat("   partial η² = λ / (λ + df_error)\n")
cat("   ⟹ λ = (partial η²) × df_error / (1 - partial η²)\n\n")

cat("   The F-test for the main effect uses:\n")
cat("   F_test = MS_effect / MS_error ~ F(df1=2, df2=df_error, ncp=λ)\n")
cat("   under the alternative hypothesis.\n\n")
cat("   Under H0 (null hypothesis of no main effect): ncp = 0\n")

# Balanced 3×2 factorial ANOVA power analysis
# Test: main effect of 3-level factor (2 numerator df)
# Effect size: partial eta-squared = 0.06
# Target power: 80%, alpha = 0.05

# Parameters
alpha <- 0.05
target_power <- 0.80
partial_eta_sq <- 0.06
numerator_df <- 2  # 3-level factor has 2 df
factor_levels <- 3
second_factor_levels <- 2
total_cells <- factor_levels * second_factor_levels

# Relationship: partial eta² = λ / (λ + df_error)
# where λ is the noncentrality parameter and df_error = N - p
# N = total sample size, p = number of parameters in full model
# Full model has: 1 intercept + (3-1) + (2-1) + (3-1)(2-1) = 1 + 2 + 1 + 2 = 6 parameters
p <- 1 + (factor_levels - 1) + (second_factor_levels - 1) + (factor_levels - 1) * (second_factor_levels - 1)

cat("Full factorial model parameters:", p, "\n")
cat("Total cells:", total_cells, "\n")
cat("Each cell has n participants\n")
cat("Total N = n *", total_cells, "\n\n")

# Test parameters
critical_f <- qf(1 - alpha, numerator_df, df = Inf)  # approximate upper tail
cat("Critical F-value (df1=2, alpha=0.05, large df):", critical_f, "\n\n")

# Solve for n: minimum participants per cell
# Strategy: search for smallest integer n giving power >= 0.80

power_results <- data.frame(n = integer(), df_error = integer(), lambda = numeric(), power = numeric())

for (n in 1:500) {
  # Total sample size
  N <- n * total_cells
  
  # Error degrees of freedom
  df_error <- N - p
  
  if (df_error <= 0) next
  
  # Convert partial eta² to noncentrality parameter λ
  # partial_eta² = λ / (λ + df_error)
  # λ = partial_eta² * df_error / (1 - partial_eta²)
  lambda <- partial_eta_sq * df_error / (1 - partial_eta_sq)
  
  # Power: P(F > F_crit) where F ~ F(2, df_error, lambda)
  power <- 1 - pf(qf(1 - alpha, numerator_df, df_error), 
                   numerator_df, df_error, ncp = lambda)
  
  power_results <- rbind(power_results, 
                         data.frame(n = n, df_error = df_error, lambda = lambda, power = power))
  
  # Stop once we exceed target power
  if (power >= target_power) break
}

# Display results around the target
target_idx <- which(power_results$power >= target_power)[1]
display_range <- max(1, target_idx - 2):min(nrow(power_results), target_idx + 2)

cat("Power calculation results:\n")
print(power_results[display_range, ], row.names = FALSE)

# Minimum n meeting target power
n_min <- power_results$n[target_idx]
power_achieved <- power_results$power[target_idx]
df_error_achieved <- power_results$df_error[target_idx]
lambda_achieved <- power_results$lambda[target_idx]

cat("\n=== RESULT ===\n")
cat("Minimum participants per cell (n):", n_min, "\n")
cat("Power achieved:", round(power_achieved, 4), "\n")
cat("Total N = n * 6 =", n_min * total_cells, "\n")
cat("Error df =", df_error_achieved, "\n")
cat("Noncentrality parameter λ =", round(lambda_achieved, 4), "\n\n")

# Verify preceding design (n-1)
if (n_min > 1) {
  n_prev <- n_min - 1
  N_prev <- n_prev * total_cells
  df_error_prev <- N_prev - p
  lambda_prev <- partial_eta_sq * df_error_prev / (1 - partial_eta_sq)
  power_prev <- 1 - pf(qf(1 - alpha, numerator_df, df_error_prev), 
                        numerator_df, df_error_prev, ncp = lambda_prev)
  
  cat("Verification - preceding design (n =", n_prev, "):\n")
  cat("  Power:", round(power_prev, 4), "\n")
  cat("  Does not meet 80% target:", power_prev < target_power, "\n\n")
}

# Summary table
cat("=== DESIGN SUMMARY ===\n")
cat("Design: Balanced 3 × 2 factorial ANOVA\n")
cat("Cells: 6 (3 levels × 2 levels)\n")
cat("Test: Main effect of 3-level factor\n")
cat("Numerator df:", numerator_df, "\n")
cat("Effect size (partial η²):", partial_eta_sq, "\n")
cat("Significance level (α):", alpha, "\n")
cat("Target power:", target_power, "\n\n")
cat("MINIMUM SAMPLE SIZE: n =", n_min, "participants per cell\n")
cat("Total N =", n_min * total_cells, "participants\n")
cat("Achieved power:", round(power_achieved, 4), "\n")

# Output for POWER_AGENT_RESULT
result_json <- list(
  results = list(
    list(metric = "sample_size", value = n_min, unit = "participants_per_cell"),
    list(metric = "achieved_power", value = round(power_achieved, 4), unit = "proportion"),
    list(metric = "total_N", value = n_min * total_cells, unit = "participants")
  ),
  verification = list(
    preceding_design_n = if (n_min > 1) n_min - 1 else NA,
    preceding_design_power = if (n_min > 1) round(power_prev, 4) else NA
  )
)

cat("   - All 6 cells independent\n")
cat("   - Full interaction model (3-1)(2-1) = 2 interaction parameters\n")
cat("   - Model: Y ~ A + B + A:B\n")
cat("   - Total parameters p = 1 + 2 + 1 + 2 = 6\n\n")

# 2. Hypothesis
cat("2. HYPOTHESIS TEST\n")
cat("   - H0: μ_1 = μ_2 = μ_3 (main effect of 3-level factor)\n")
cat("   - H1: at least one level mean differs\n")
cat("   - Numerator df = 3 - 1 = 2\n")
cat("   - Sidedness: two-sided (α split into upper tail of F-distribution)\n")
cat("   - Significance level α = 0.05\n\n")

# 3. Effect size conversion
cat("3. EFFECT SIZE CONVERSION\n")
cat("   - Given: partial η² = 0.06\n")
cat("   - Formula: partial η² = λ / (λ + df_error)\n")
cat("   - Rearranging: λ = (partial η²) × df_error / (1 - partial η²)\n")
cat("   - Example (n=27): df_error = 162 - 6 = 156\n")

df_error_ex <- 162 - 6
lambda_ex <- 0.06 * df_error_ex / (1 - 0.06)
cat("   - λ =", 0.06, "×", df_error_ex, "/", 1 - 0.06, "=", round(lambda_ex, 4), "\n\n")

# 4. Power calculation

cat("   - Test statistic: F(df1=2, df2=156) under H0\n")
cat("   - Critical value: F_0.05(2,156) =", round(qf(0.95, 2, 156), 6), "\n")

cat("   - Power = P(F > F_crit | H1) = 1 - P(F ≤ F_crit | ncp=λ)\n")

F_crit <- qf(0.95, 2, 156)
power_ex <- 1 - pf(F_crit, 2, 156, ncp = lambda_ex)
cat("   - Power = 1 - P(F ≤", round(F_crit, 6), "|λ=", round(lambda_ex, 4), ")\n")
cat("   - Power =", round(power_ex, 4), "\n\n")

cat("   λ = (N × partial η²) / (1 - partial η²) × (df_error / total_df)\n")
cat("   \n")
cat("   Equivalently, from the definitional relationship:\n")
cat("   partial η² = λ / (λ + df_error)\n")

# N = total sample size, p = number of parameters in full model
# Full model has: 1 intercept + (3-1) + (2-1) + (3-1)(2-1) = 1 + 2 + 1 + 2 = 6 parameters
p <- 1 + (factor_levels - 1) + (second_factor_levels - 1) + (factor_levels - 1) * (second_factor_levels - 1)

cat("Full factorial model parameters:", p, "\n")
cat("Total cells:", total_cells, "\n")
cat("Each cell has n participants\n")
cat("Total N = n *", total_cells, "\n\n")

# Test parameters
critical_f <- qf(1 - alpha, numerator_df, df = Inf)  # approximate upper tail
cat("Critical F-value (df1=2, alpha=0.05, large df):", critical_f, "\n\n")

# Solve for n: minimum participants per cell
# Strategy: search for smallest integer n giving power >= 0.80

power_results <- data.frame(n = integer(), df_error = integer(), lambda = numeric(), power = numeric())

for (n in 1:500) {

  N <- n * total_cells

  if (df_error <= 0) next

  lambda <- partial_eta_sq * df_error / (1 - partial_eta_sq)
